title: Part 6 公告與通知
summary: 電梯檢修、圖書館延長開放：公告的固定寫法。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: 公告的結構很固定：發生什麼事 → 時間 → 對大家的影響 → 請大家做什麼 → 感謝。
知道這個順序，句子題就很好猜：說完「不方便」，接下來通常是「我們會怎麼幫忙」。

steps.title: 解題技巧

head: 題型
選項長相
怎麼解
rows: 看日期；東西「被做」用被動
so that ＋ 句子：為了能夠…

steps.tip: patience（耐心）和 patients（病人）發音很像，Part 6 很愛考。

items.en: The elevators will be inspected on Saturday.
items.zh: 電梯將在星期六進行檢查。

items.en: We thank you for your patience.
The library will extend its hours.
items.zh: 圖書館將延長開放時間。

items.en: For more information, please visit our website.
items.zh: 更多資訊請上我們的網站。

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 每題都會顯示整篇文章，看到第幾個空格就作答那一格。

questions.prompt: 第 1 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: 電梯是「被檢查」，日期是之後的星期六，用 will be inspected。
questions.text:
NOTICE

The elevators in this building (1)______ on Saturday, June 8, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. During this time, please use the stairs. We understand this may be difficult for some people. (2)______ If you need help (3)______ heavy items, please contact the front desk. We thank you for your (4)______.

questions.prompt: 第 2 個空格要填什麼？
options: Staff will be available to help with deliveries.
The new elevators are very fast.
questions.answer: Staff will be available to help with deliveries.
questions.explanation: 前一句說可能造成不便，接「會有工作人員幫忙」最合理。

questions.prompt: 第 3 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: need help ＋ V-ing：需要幫忙做某事。

questions.prompt: 第 4 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: your 後面接名詞，「耐心」是 patience；patients 是病人。

optionNotes.patient: patient（名詞／形容詞）是「病人；有耐心的」

questions.prompt: 第 5 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: will 後面接動詞原形 extend（延長）。
questions.text:
Greenville Public Library

Starting next month, the library will (5)______ its hours. It will open at 8 a.m. instead of 9 a.m. on weekdays. Many visitors asked for earlier hours (6)______ they could study before work. (7)______ The weekend hours will not change. For more (8)______, please visit our website.

questions.prompt: 第 6 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: 後面是句子 they could study，表示目的「為了能夠…」，用 so that。
questions.text:
Greenville Public Library

Starting next month, the library will (5)______ its hours. It will open at 8 a.m. instead of 9 a.m. on weekdays. Many visitors asked for earlier hours (6)______ they could study before work. (7)______ The weekend hours will not change. For more (8)______, please visit our website.

questions.prompt: 第 7 個空格要填什麼？
options: We are happy to meet their needs.
The library will be closed for good.
questions.answer: We are happy to meet their needs.
questions.explanation: 前一句說讀者希望早點開，接「很高興滿足他們的需求」。

optionNotes.informative: informative（形容詞）是「提供資訊的；有益的」

questions.explanation: patience 耐心；patient 有耐心的（也可當病人）；patients 病人（複數）。
so that ＋ 句子：表示目的。
